scripts.bootstrap: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdk bootstrap  --version-reporting false --asset-metadata false -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.diff: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdk diff '**' --version-reporting false --asset-metadata false -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.synth: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdk synth '**' --version-reporting false --asset-metadata false --quiet -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.deploy:all: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdk deploy --all --version-reporting false --asset-metadata false -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.stage:deploy:all: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdk deploy '**' --version-reporting false --asset-metadata false -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.delstack2: cross-env CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV} --query Account --output text) delstack cdk -f -y -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.d:bootstrap: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdkd bootstrap --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.d:diff: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdkd diff '**' -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
scripts.d:stage:deploy:all: cross-env COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) cdkd deploy '**' -c project=${PROJECT} -c env=${ENV} --profile ${PROJECT}-${ENV}
